finalText:
Written to `HANDOFF.md`.

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` set `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true`, exhausting the 20-slot pool. All 530 503s carry a paired `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED` at `size 20, in_use 20`; no upstream errors anywhere.

**Impact window:** 02:14:18Z onset → 03:59:27Z end of log, still failing. 530/1228 requests (~43%), all five business paths evenly. `/health` stayed 200 throughout; on-call paged 67 min late.

**Roll back:** `dep-4471` — revert config generation 119 → 118 as a unit (it also carried `upstreamMs 2000→2500`, which compounds the hold time). Verify across all three nodes; this log is node-3 only.

The doc also flags two things: the logs are dated 2026-03-14 while today is 2026-08-26, so confirm you're on live data first; and the worker latency climb is a separate pre-existing issue (OPS-2210), not part of this incident.
